scenes.narration: Chia ruộng, đòi quyền lợi cho từng giai cấp, đều tạm gác lại.
scenes.image: In the hut: the older cadre in brown carefully puts a bundle of papers, a small sickle and a rolled land map into a wooden box at the side, closing the lid gently, meaning "for later".

scenes.narration: Nghị quyết viết, đại ý: chưa đòi được độc lập, thì quyền lợi của giai cấp nào, đến vạn năm cũng không đòi lại được.
scenes.image: Close-up: an old resolution paper on the bamboo table with wavy grey lines and one round red BLANK seal mark, lit by the oil lamp, solemn mood. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no faces.

scenes.narration: Muốn gom mọi người Việt yêu nước, phải có một mặt trận chung.
scenes.image: A long row of different Vietnamese people standing shoulder to shoulder, arms linked: a farmer in brown with a hoe, a factory worker in blue, a student in white, a woman trader with a basket, an old scholar in a black gown, a Tay woman and a Nung man in indigo; hopeful faces.

scenes.narration: Tên đầy đủ là Việt Nam độc lập đồng minh. Gọi tắt: Việt Minh.
scenes.image: Inside the bamboo hut: all the cadres raise their hands in agreement around the low table, the very thin man in indigo nods with a satisfied smile; the young cadre in khaki beams. Keep the top quarter of the frame simple (sky, mist or plain rock), room for a big title.
scenes.title: VIỆT MINH · 19.5.1941

scenes.narration: Ngày thành lập là 19 tháng 5, đúng ngày sinh của Người.
scenes.image: After the meeting in the hut: the young cadre in khaki shyly offers the very thin man in indigo a small bunch of wild forest flowers on a leaf, the man laughs warmly and accepts it.

scenes.narration: Mấy tuần sau, ngày 6 tháng 6, một lá thư được gửi đi khắp nước.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese messenger in brown clothes and a conical hat slips a rolled letter into a bamboo tube and runs down a mountain path; below him many small paths branch out to rice fields and villages in the plains.

scenes.narration: "Hỡi các bậc phụ huynh! Hỡi các hiền nhân chí sĩ!"
scenes.image: A village square under a big banyan tree: a young man holds up an unrolled letter (wavy lines only) and reads it aloud; villagers in brown clothes and conical hats crowd around to listen, an old man cups his ear. Keep the top quarter of the frame simple (sky, mist or plain rock), room for a big title.
scenes.title: KÍNH CÁO ĐỒNG BÀO

scenes.narration: Cuối thư ký một cái tên: Nguyễn Ái Quốc.
scenes.image: Close-up: the bottom of a handwritten letter (wavy lines only) on a bamboo table; a hand holding a pen finishes a signature drawn as a single wavy flourish; oil lamp light. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, only one hand.

scenes.narration: Chín năm trước, báo chí đã đưa tin người mang tên ấy chết trong tù.
scenes.image: Close-up: the old yellowed 1932 newspaper again, its black-bordered BLANK box with the small photo of the thin man; dust and a cobweb on it in a dark archive drawer. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no faces except the small photo.

scenes.narration: Trong hồ sơ mật thám Pháp, cái tên ấy đã có chữ "chết".
scenes.image: In a high-ceilinged French Surete office in Hanoi 1941: ochre-yellow walls, tall dark green shutters with tropical light, a heavy dark wooden desk with a black telephone and a brass lamp, grey metal filing cabinets: on the desk a thick dossier lies open with a small photo of the thin man clipped to it and a big blood-red BLANK stamp mark across the page; the tall thin bald French officer taps it smugly with his pen.

scenes.narration: Bạn thử hình dung viên mật thám, khi lá thư ấy rơi lên bàn.
scenes.image: In a high-ceilinged French Surete office in Hanoi 1941: ochre-yellow walls, tall dark green shutters with tropical light, a heavy dark wooden desk with a black telephone and a brass lamp, grey metal filing cabinets: a letter flutters down onto the desk; the tall thin bald French officer jumps up from his chair, eyes wide behind his round glasses which slip down his nose, his pen dropping, utterly shocked.

scenes.narration: Lá thư đã có. Nhưng phần lớn người dân khi ấy không biết chữ.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese village in the plains: an old woman and a farmer in brown hold a letter (wavy lines) upside down, puzzled, scratching their heads; a buffalo behind them.

scenes.narration: Vậy làm sao để lời kêu gọi đến được với họ?
scenes.image: By the stream: the very thin man in indigo sits on a rock with his chin in his hand, thinking hard, a stack of papers beside him.

scenes.narration: Ngày 1 tháng 8 năm 1941, giữa rừng, một tờ báo nhỏ ra đời: Việt Nam Độc lập.
scenes.image: Close-up in a forest clearing: a small freshly printed newspaper sheet in purple ink, a big blank title band at the top and a simple drawing of a farmer with a hoe, the rest wavy lines; sun dapples through the leaves. Keep the top quarter of the frame simple (sky, mist or plain rock), room for a big title. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no faces.

scenes.narration: Không có máy in. Báo được in trên đá.

scenes.narration: Chữ viết lên mặt đá phẳng, rồi lăn mực, ép giấy, in từng tờ một.

scenes.image: The very thin man in indigo writes an article on a sheet with a pen at a bamboo table, and on another sheet beside it draws a simple picture of a farmer with a hoe; focused, gentle.

scenes.narration: Câu ngắn, chữ to, đọc lên là hiểu.
scenes.image: Close-up of a printed sheet: a few short thick wavy lines (no letters) and a simple big drawing; a villager's finger points at the drawing with delight. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, only one finger.

scenes.narration: Ở Pác Bó, bàn làm việc là đá, máy in cũng là đá.
scenes.image: Two flat stone slabs side by side in the forest: on the left one an open book and a pen (a desk), on the right one an ink roller and fresh printed sheets (a press); morning light. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no faces.

scenes.narration: Rồi mùa xuân thứ hai đến. Xuân Nhâm Ngọ, 1942.
scenes.image: Spring 1942 at Pac Bo: fresh light-green spring leaves on the trees along the clear blue-green stream at Pac Bo flowing over round pebbles at the foot of green limestone peaks, the dark cave mouth in the cliff behind, blue sky with white clouds, fresh green. scenes.image: An illustrated booklet page made of four small framed vignettes in flat cartoon style: two Vietnamese heroines riding war elephants; a general with stakes in a river and wooden warships; a leader in armour raising a sword under a tree; a warrior king on horseback charging at dawn; no text. scenes.narration: Ai không biết chữ, nghe đọc vài lần là thuộc.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese farmer in brown ploughs a terraced field behind a water buffalo, singing happily with his mouth open and musical notes drawn as small simple swirls around him; mountains behind.

scenes.narration: Câu kết sách, Người nhắc một chữ "đồng": đồng tình, đồng sức, đồng lòng, đồng minh.
scenes.image: Close-up: four hands of different people (a farmer, a woman, a young man, an old man) placed one on top of another on the open booklet, warm light. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, only hands.

scenes.narration: Và ngay sau đó là bảng những năm quan trọng.
scenes.image: Close-up: the last page of the booklet: a neat table of many short rows (wavy grey lines only), each row beginning with a small wavy mark, a finger moving down the rows toward the bottom. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, only one finger.

scenes.narration: Dòng cuối cùng: năm 1945, Việt Nam độc lập.

scenes.narration: Vậy con số ấy từ đâu ra? Một lời tiên tri ư?
scenes.image: Inside the cave by lamp light: on the stone a fortune teller's crystal ball glows mysteriously, but the very thin man in indigo ignores it and studies a stack of newspapers and a world map instead.

scenes.narration: Sử không chép Người tính toán thế nào. Nhưng hãy nhìn tấm bản đồ thế giới năm ấy.
scenes.image: Inside the cave: a big old world map (no labels) pinned to the rock wall, covered with small arrows and pins; the very thin man in indigo stands in front of it with a lamp, studying it closely.

scenes.narration: Tháng 6 năm 1940, nước Pháp thua Đức. Pa-ri bị chiếm.
scenes.image: Paris in June 1940, a sad grey day: the Eiffel Tower stands over an empty avenue with closed shutters and fallen leaves; far away a long column of small grey military trucks rolls down the avenue; a lone Parisian woman in a 1940 coat watches from a doorway with a worried face; no flags, no symbols, no emblems. scenes.narration: Ba tháng sau, quân Nhật kéo vào Đông Dương.
scenes.image: September 1940, a mountain border gate in northern Indochina: a column of Japanese soldiers in khaki with rifles and a few military trucks march in through the stone gate; French soldiers in white stand aside.

scenes.narration: Một xứ thuộc địa giờ có hai ông chủ. Cả hai đều đang dính vào một cuộc chiến lớn.
scenes.image: Visual metaphor: a thin Vietnamese farmer in brown bends under a bamboo shoulder pole; on one end sits a fat French colonial official in white with a pith helmet, on the other end a Japanese officer in khaki with a sword; the two masters glare at each other.

scenes.narration: Hai ông chủ ấy không thể chung nhau mãi. Và chiến tranh nào rồi cũng tàn.
scenes.image: Visual metaphor: the French official in white and the Japanese officer in khaki pull hard on opposite ends of a long map of Indochina like a tug of war, the map tearing in the middle; dark storm clouds of war above them.

scenes.narration: Người nông dân không biết ngày nào trời mưa. Nhưng họ biết mùa nào mưa, nên gieo hạt từ trước.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese farmer in brown sows seeds by hand in a freshly ploughed terraced field, while far away on the horizon dark rain clouds are gathering; calm and wise.

scenes.narration: Người cũng vậy. Người không đoán ngày, Người đoán mùa.
scenes.image: The very thin man in indigo kneels on the hillside at Pac Bo, planting a small seed in the dark earth with his hand, glancing up at the far rain clouds with a calm knowing look.

scenes.narration: Mặt trận, tờ báo, cuốn sử, những lớp học trong rừng: tất cả là hạt giống gieo trước mùa mưa.
scenes.image: A hillside of small green seedlings; among them, as if they grew from the seeds, small things appear: a bamboo hut, a stack of printed sheets, a thin booklet, a small group of young cadres studying under a tree; rain clouds coming from afar. Nobody in the scene: only the small group of cadres far away.

scenes.narration: Và mùa ấy đến thật. Tháng 3 năm 1945, Nhật lật đổ Pháp.
scenes.image: Night of 9 March 1945 at a colonial citadel in Hanoi: Japanese soldiers in khaki with rifles disarm French soldiers in white who raise their hands; searchlights, flat navy sky. Keep the top quarter of the frame simple (sky, mist or plain rock), room for a big title.

scenes.image: A small market town street in Guangxi, China, 1942, with grey brick houses and BLANK shop signs: two Chinese soldiers in grey-blue 1940s Nationalist army uniforms and caps grab the arms of the very thin man in indigo; he stays calm and upright.

scenes.narration: Và lần thứ hai, ở quê nhà, người ta nghe tin Người đã chết.

scenes.narration: Những ngày trong ngục ấy, Vy sẽ kể bạn nghe ở tập sau nhé.
scenes.image: The very thin man in indigo sits calmly on a wooden bench in a small bare grey room with one small high window with iron bars, a beam of light falling on him, calm and dignified, determined eyes.
